Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1025
Claimant:
Melissa King
Adjuster:
Darin Tyler
10/02/2024
Claim reported by the claimant following a side impact at an intersection. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer,
and a knee injury is listed on the first notice of loss.
10/14/2024
Reviewed the claimant's account of the collision, which was consistent across each conversation held so far. Police
records and a witness statement confirm the claimant was in the vehicle at the time of the crash.
11/01/2024
Inspected the vehicle photos supplied by the repair shop. The dents sit on the opposite side of the car and at a
different height from the impact described, so the damage pattern does not match the account given. No earlier
damage to the vehicle is known, and nothing suggests the damage predates the start of coverage.
11/25/2024
Nothing independent confirms the accident itself. There are no witnesses beyond those already noted, no photos
from the scene, and no other report on file. The driver is a member of the policyholder's household and is covered as
such.
12/31/2024
Medical records show a course of treatment for the knee that followed a usual pattern and tapered off as the patient
improved. No earlier injury to the same area is known. It is still unclear whether this injury was caused by the crash.
01/27/2025
Next step is to request the full medical file and the repair estimate, then reassess causation of the knee injury and the
mismatch in damage before any decision on the claim.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
